lyrics:
[Intro - chest-pounding drums]

[Verse 1]
鉄の森を 揺らす咆哮
胸を叩いて 鳴らす太鼓

足場を蹴って 跳ぶ電光

[Instrumental Break - war drums and glitch electronics]

[Chorus]
